findings: Back matter added 2026-10-29 on the owner's request: the model paper 'Model Paper Computer Science and Entrepreneurship Intermediate part-II' (PDF 143-145, printed 139-141; PDF 146 is a duplicate scan of PDF 145) as a Practice item, hidden from Learn, solved in both languages.

Headings, instructions, marks and times as printed (Objective: Question 1, 15 MCQs, 15 marks, 20 mins; Subjective: 60 marks, 2:10 hours; Section I Q2-Q4, 9 short questions each, attempt six, 6*2=12; Section II Q5-Q9, attempt any three, 3*8=24).

The model paper prints no answer key. MCQs are keyed from the chapters' text: 1d 2c 3c 4c 5c 6b 7b 8c 9c 10a 11c 12b 13b 14a 15b. Fourteen of the fifteen are the chapter exercises' MCQs (some with reordered options); MCQ 14 (AWS) is new and keyed from 8.1 'Examples: AWS, Microsoft Azure'.

Printed errors: MCQ 9 'Which ython module' and option (c) 'unitest' (Python, unittest), and the instruction 'Cuttings are filling two or more circles' (cutting or filling); each has a Book correction / Kitab ki ghalti box. Q2 v 'What it means when...' and the long-question punctuation are kept as printed.

Answers reuse the solved chapter exercises where the question is the same (Q2 i, Q3 i, Q4 vi, vii, ix; Q5 = Ch1 Long 3, Q7 = Ch6 Long 6, Q8 = Ch8 Long 2, Q9 = Ch9 Long 3); the rest are written from the chapters' lessons. Comparisons (Q2 viii, Q3 viii, Q4 i) are answer tables.

Not stated in the book, answered from standard knowledge: Q2 v tautology (the book teaches satisfiability, not the word tautology), Q3 iii Entry.delete(0, END) (the book teaches Entry and get() only), Q4 iii the name 'Type I error' (the book says only that alpha is the risk of error), and the DNS-phonebook comparison (Q2 iii) built on 1.7.

Q6 program (Grandfather, Father, Son multilevel inheritance) written for this paper after the book's Vehicle/Car/ElectricCar example and run with python -I; its output is stated. Q3 ii and Q3 ix were also checked with python -I (health 100; ZeroDivisionError, with TypeError if the raw input string is used).
